title: 2025年12月 第1套

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: A terrified cat has survived a five-mile round trip under the engine cover of a car on a school run.
lines.translation: 一只受惊的猫在一辆汽车的引擎盖下完成了五英里的往返行程，这辆车当时正在接送孩子上学。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The black cat was found curled up under the engine cover of David King's car when he decided to do an oil check after dropping his grandson off at school in Kent.
lines.translation: 当David King在Kent郡送完孙子上学后决定检查机油时,发现这只黑猫蜷缩在他汽车的引擎盖下。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Mr King's wife said her husband had come "running in" and was "shouting for me to come have a look".
lines.translation: King先生的妻子说,她丈夫"跑进来""喊我过去看看"。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: "We weren't even sure it was alive, so I gently pushed it with a stick to check it was breathing and saw it was a terrified little cat.
lines.translation: "我们甚至不确定它还活着 所以我轻轻地用棍子推它 检查它是否呼吸 并看到它是一个吓坏了的小猫

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: It reversed even further into the engine and was stuck.
lines.translation: 它进一步倒转到发动机上,被卡住了。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I tried to reach it, but it was too far down and there wasn't any way I could get it out."
lines.translation: 我试图达到它, 但它是太远了下来, 并且没有任何办法,我可以把它弄出来。"

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Following a rescue by UK charity Cats Protection, the four-year-old cat was later reunited with its owner, Mr King's neighbour.
lines.translation: 经过英国慈善机构Cats Protection的救援,这只四岁的猫后来与它的主人——King先生的邻居团聚了。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 1. Where was the black cat found?
lines.translation: 第 1 题：这只黑猫是在哪里被发现的?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 2. What do we learn about the cat at the end of the news report?
lines.translation: 第 2 题：关于这只猫,新闻报道最后我们了解到什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: In less than a month, the Special Olympics Spring Games will make a return to Fayetteville.
lines.translation: 不到一个月后,特殊奥林匹克春季运动会将重返Fayetteville。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The Games are coming back for the first time in five years.
lines.translation: 这是该运动会五年来首次回归。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The event will take place at Methodist University.
lines.translation: 活动将在Methodist University举行。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Event organizer Benjamin Kowalczyk says he's excited that athletes will get a chance to come back and demonstrate their abilities.
lines.translation: 活动组织者Benjamin Kowalczyk表示,他很高兴运动员们将有机会回来展示他们的能力。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Organizers expect about 100 athletes will come out to compete in Fayetteville.
lines.translation: 组织者预计约有100名运动员将来到Fayetteville参加比赛。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: They will have a variety of events to choose from, including running, throwing, and jumping.
lines.translation: 他们将有多种项目可供选择,包括跑步、投掷和跳跃。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: There will also be a fun tent for children.
lines.translation: 现场还将设有儿童趣味帐篷。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Kowalczyk said it's rewarding to see athletes with special needs triumph in the Games.
lines.translation: Kowalczyk说,看到有特殊需求的运动员在运动会上取得胜利是很有意义的。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: For anyone who wants to help make this year's Games a massive success, there are still opportunities to volunteer for Fayetteville's Special Olympics.
lines.translation: 对于任何想要帮助今年运动会取得巨大成功的人,仍有机会为Fayetteville特殊奥林匹克运动会做志愿者。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Organizers encourage them to visit the Games' website to sign up.
lines.translation: 组织者鼓励他们访问运动会网站进行报名。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Questions 3 and 4 are based on the news report you have just heard.
lines.translation: 问题3和4 是基于你刚刚听到的新闻报导。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 3. What will Fayetteville witness in less than a month?
lines.translation: 第 3 题：不到一个月后，Fayetteville 将见证什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 4. What did Benjamin Kowalczyk say is rewarding to see?
lines.translation: 第 4 题：Benjamin Kowalczyk 说看到什么令人欣慰?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: News Report 3.
lines.translation: 《新闻报告3》。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: A German supermarket has been ordered to destroy its chocolate rabbits after it lost a court battle with a Swiss chocolate manufacturer.
lines.translation: 一家德国超市在与一家瑞士巧克力制造商的法庭诉讼中败诉后,被勒令销毁其巧克力兔子产品。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The Swiss firm had argued its gold-wrapped chocolate rabbit deserved copyright protection from a similar product sold by the budget supermarket.
lines.translation: 这家瑞士公司辩称,其金色包装的巧克力兔子应当受到版权保护,以防止这家廉价超市销售的类似产品侵权。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Switzerland's highest court agreed and overturned a ruling last year by the country's commercial court that had sided with the supermarket.
lines.translation: 瑞士最高法院同意并推翻了去年与超市站在一起的瑞士商业法院的裁决。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: It ordered that all the imitation rabbits be destroyed, but suggested the chocolate needn't be wasted.
lines.translation: 它下令销毁所有的模仿兔子 但建议巧克力不要浪费

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: It could be melted for use in other products.
lines.translation: 它可以熔化,用于其他产品。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: It said even though there are some differences between the two products, there was still the possibility of confusion for consumers.
lines.translation: 法院称,尽管两种产品之间存在一些差异,但仍有可能使消费者产生混淆。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The Swiss manufacturer's rabbit has a red bow and bell, while the German supermarket's has a green bow and bell.
lines.translation: 瑞士制造商的兔子有红色蝴蝶结和铃铛,而德国超市的兔子有绿色蝴蝶结和铃铛。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The colour of the wrapper is similar, as are the illustrations of the features.
lines.translation: 包装纸的颜色相似,特征的图案也相似。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The chocolate company has been to court before to protect its popular chocolate treat.
lines.translation: 这家巧克力公司此前曾诉诸法庭以保护其畅销巧克力产品。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Last year, a German federal court said the shade of the gold wrapping was also protected.
lines.translation: 去年,德国联邦法院裁定金色包装纸的色调也受到保护。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 5. What has the German supermarket been ordered to do?
lines.translation: 第 5 题：这家德国超市被要求做什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 6. What did Switzerland's highest court suggest about the chocolate in question?
lines.translation: 第 6 题：瑞士最高法院对有关巧克力提出了什么建议?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 7. Why did Switzerland's highest court overturn the commercial court's ruling?
lines.translation: 第 7 题：瑞士最高法院为什么推翻商事法院的裁决?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Section B. Directions.
lines.translation: B节. 指示。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: In this section, you will hear two long conversations.
lines.translation: 在本节中,你们将听到两次长长的谈话。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: At the end of each conversation,
lines.translation: 每次谈话结束时

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: you will hear four questions.
lines.translation: 你会听到四个问题。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Both the conversation and the questions will be spoken only once.
lines.translation: 谈话和问题只谈一次

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A, B, C, and D. Then mark the corresponding letter
lines.translation: 在听到一个问题后,你必须从四个选择中选择最好的答案,四个选择标有A、B、C和D。然后在相应的字母上标出相应的字母

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: on answer sheet
lines.translation: 答题表

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: one with a line the center.
lines.translation: 中间有一条线

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Can you please hand me that book over there?
lines.translation: 你能把那边那本书递给我吗？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: It has instructions for making a winter bean salad.
lines.translation: 上面有冬季豆子沙拉的做法。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: My sister's boyfriend is coming over for dinner.
lines.translation: 我姐姐的男朋友要过来吃晚饭。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: He's vegetarian, so I need to make a lot of vegetable dishes.
lines.translation: 他是素食主义者，所以我得做很多蔬菜菜肴。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: He only eats vegetables, no meat?
lines.translation: 他只吃蔬菜,没有肉?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: That doesn't sound like a very balanced diet.
lines.translation: 这听起来不像是 一种非常平衡的饮食。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: How can he get enough protein?
lines.translation: 他怎么能得到足够的蛋白质?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: What does he do to strengthen his muscles and all that?
lines.translation: 他做了什么来强化他的肌肉?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Apparently that's no problem.
lines.translation: 显然这不是问题。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: He's explained this to me when we first met.
lines.translation: 我们第一次见面时他跟我解释过。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: He eats a variety of different vegetables and nuts, especially those with high amounts of protein.
lines.translation: 他吃各种不同的蔬菜和坚果,尤其是那些蛋白质含量高的。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: It sounds a bit difficult, but he's done his research I suppose.
lines.translation: 听起来有点困难 但他已经做了研究

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: What's his reasoning for being vegetarian?
lines.translation: 素食者有什么理由?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Is it his religion, health condition, or lifestyle?
lines.translation: 是他的宗教、健康状况还是生活方式?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: He's an animal activist.
lines.translation: 他是个动物保护主义者。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: He's always been very sensitive and sympathizes with animals.
lines.translation: 他一直很敏感,同情动物。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: He's even written to his state senator about the torture of dolphins in sea parks.
lines.translation: 他甚至给他所在州的参议员写信,抗议海洋公园虐待海豚。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: He says that keeping animals in zoos and parks causes them great distress.
lines.translation: 他说把动物关在动物园和公园里会给它们造成巨大的痛苦。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: That's a little gloomy, but I can understand that to a point.
lines.translation: 这有点悲观,不过我在某种程度上能理解。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Not all zoos and animal parks have the most favorable conditions, but without them it just wouldn't be feasible to learn about animals and their environments.
lines.translation: 不是所有动物园和动物公园的条件都最理想,但没有它们的话,了解动物及其生存环境根本就不可行。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Besides, I don't think I could ever give up a good hot dog at a baseball game.
lines.translation: 再说,我觉得我永远都放弃不了在棒球赛上吃根美味热狗。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Honestly, I agree, but just don't let him hear you say that.
lines.translation: 老实说,我同意,不过别让他听到你这么说。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: He's the spokesperson for his local animal rights group.
lines.translation: 他是当地动物权利组织的发言人。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 8. What does the man request the woman to do?
lines.translation: 第 8 题：男士要求女士做什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 9. What does the woman say about eating vegetables only?
lines.translation: 第 9 题：关于只吃蔬菜,女士是怎么说的?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 10. Why does the boyfriend of the man's sister choose to be a vegetarian?
lines.translation: 第 10 题：男士的姐姐的男朋友为什么选择成为素食主义者?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 11. On what point does the man agree with the woman at the end of the conversation?
lines.translation: 第 11 题：在对话结束时,男士在哪一点上同意女士的观点?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Conversation two.
lines.translation: 对话二

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Did you see that television program on air travel last night?
lines.translation: 你昨晚看那个关于航空旅行的电视节目了吗？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Yes.
lines.translation: 看了。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The part about overcoming jetlag was interesting.
lines.translation: 关于克服时差反应那部分挺有意思的。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I was surprised that the expert recommended not eating for the entire journey and avoiding sleeping on the plane.
lines.translation: 我很惊讶那个专家建议整个旅程都不吃东西，还要避免在飞机上睡觉。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I was too, as I read an article on the subject in the past that suggested the opposite.
lines.translation: 我也是，因为我以前读过一篇关于这个话题的文章，建议的是相反的做法。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: It claimed that it was important not to miss meals and that taking a nap on the plane was the best way to adjust to a new time zone.
lines.translation: 文章说不能错过用餐很重要，而且在飞机上小睡是适应新时区的最好方法。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Well, the expert on the show did cite research supporting her recommendations, so I guess I'll give it a try next time I fly a long distance.
lines.translation: 嗯，节目里那位专家确实引用了研究来支持她的建议，所以我想下次长途飞行时试试看。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Jetlag is a big problem for me and has been for the last few years, even though I never suffered from it before.
lines.translation: 时差反应对我来说是个大问题，过去几年一直这样，尽管我以前从来没有受过时差困扰。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Well, she did say that jetlag often becomes more of a problem after 40, so I guess I'm lucky that I can still adjust to different time zones well.
lines.translation: 嗯，她确实说过时差反应在40岁之后往往会变成更大的问题，所以我想我很幸运，还能很好地适应不同的时区。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: My problem is I'm afraid to fly.
lines.translation: 我的问题是我害怕坐飞机。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Oh, I didn't know that.
lines.translation: 哦，我不知道这个。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Actually, my mother is terrified of airplanes to the point where she can't even fly, so our family vacations were always by car or train.
lines.translation: 其实我妈妈特别害怕飞机，严重到根本不能坐飞机，所以我们家的假期总是开车或坐火车。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I'm not as bad as that.
lines.translation: 我没那么严重。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I just get anxious before I fly and feel nervous the whole time we're in the air, which is why I was hoping the television program would cover that topic more than it did.
lines.translation: 我只是在坐飞机前会焦虑，在空中的整个过程都感到紧张，这就是为什么我希望那个电视节目能更多地讨论这个话题，而不是像实际那样一带而过。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Yeah.
lines.translation: 是啊。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: That segment was too brief, especially as so many people have that problem.
lines.translation: 那个部分太简短了，特别是有那么多人都有这个问题。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: She said 20% of people are afraid to fly.
lines.translation: 她说20%的人害怕坐飞机。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Actually, it was a quarter of people, so the problem really is widespread and deserves attention.
lines.translation: 实际上是四分之一的人，所以这个问题确实很普遍，值得关注。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Questions 12 to 15 are based on the conversation you have just heard.
lines.translation: 问题12到15 是基于你刚才听到的谈话

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 12. What part of the TV program does the man say was interesting?
lines.translation: 第 12 题：男士说电视节目的哪部分内容很有趣?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 13. What does the man say he will do next time he flies a long distance?
lines.translation: 第 13 题：男士说他下次长途飞行时会做什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 14. Why does the woman think she is lucky?
lines.translation: 第 14 题：女士为什么认为自己很幸运?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 15. Why does the woman think the problem of being afraid to fly deserves attention?
lines.translation: 第 15 题：女士为什么认为害怕乘飞机的问题值得关注?

lines.text: Section C directions in this section you will hear three passages at the end of each passage you will hear three or four questions both the passage and the questions
lines.translation: 本节C节指示中,您将听到3个段落,在每个段落的结尾处,您将听到3个或4个问题,包括通道和问题

lines.translation: 只能说一次

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A, B, C, and D. Then mark the corresponding letter on answer sheet one with a single line through the center.
lines.translation: 在听到一个问题后,您必须选择四个选项中的最佳答案, 四个选项标有 A、 B、 C 和 D 。 然后在答题表一上用单行横穿中心标出相应的字母 。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The most common question I'm asked always centers around how to get started in user experience design, to which my response is always that nothing can substitute real-world experience.
lines.translation: 我被问到的最常见问题总是围绕如何开始从事用户体验设计，对此我的回答始终是，没有什么能替代真实世界的经验。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Building the skills required of a user experience designer takes time, patience, and commitment.
lines.translation: 培养用户体验设计师所需的技能需要时间、耐心和投入。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Higher education is a great way to equip yourself with some core skills, but it will not prepare you for actual challenges you'll face with clients' work.
lines.translation: 高等教育是让你具备一些核心技能的好方法,但它不会让你为客户工作中将面临的实际挑战做好准备。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: In other words, being proficient with a design tool and a few methods doesn't make you a user experience designer.
lines.translation: 换句话说,精通一个设计工具和几种方法并不能让你成为用户体验设计师。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: There simply isn't a one-size-fits-all process.
lines.translation: 根本不存在一个放之四海而皆准的流程。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Being effective requires adaptability — something you don't really learn in school, much less in a 6-month training camp.
lines.translation: 要做到有效需要适应能力——这是你在学校里真正学不到的,更不用说在6个月的培训营中了。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: It's gained through experience on the job and learning what's appropriate given the needs of the project.
lines.translation: 它是通过工作中的经验获得的,并学会根据项目需求选择合适的方法。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I found my way to user experience through graphic design and slowly over many different roles and experiences.
lines.translation: 我通过平面设计找到了进入用户体验的道路,并在许多不同的角色和经历中慢慢成长。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: That led me to become a user experience designer.
lines.translation: 这让我成为了一名用户体验设计师。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: It took time and commitment to continue to pursue roles within teams that I knew could teach and challenge me.
lines.translation: 这需要时间和投入来持续追求那些我知道能教导和挑战我的团队中的角色。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: That's not to say that I think my path is the only one.
lines.translation: 这并不是说我认为我的道路是唯一的。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: But once again, nothing can substitute real-world experience.
lines.translation: 但再次强调,没有什么能替代真实世界的经验。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: You can start anywhere as long as you know your end goal and you commit to actively pursuing opportunities to learn and grow along the way.
lines.translation: 只要你知道自己的最终目标,并致力于积极寻求学习和成长的机会,你可以从任何地方开始。

lines.text: When planning for this year,
lines.translation: 当规划今年的时候

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I responded in a whisper "flexible seating", thinking about our then-current classroom.
lines.translation: 我小声回答"灵活座位",同时想到我们当时的教室。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: It had rows of desks with blue chairs and nameplates reminding each student where they should be sitting.
lines.translation: 教室里一排排课桌配着蓝色椅子,桌上的姓名牌提醒着每个学生应该坐在哪里。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: This began a journey to transform our practice and challenge the ways of learning for a group of Year 6 students used to sitting in desks and rows for years.
lines.translation: 这开启了一段转变我们教学实践的旅程,并挑战了一群习惯于多年坐在课桌排列教室里的六年级学生的学习方式。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Flexible seating has been defined as movable furniture to create an engaging learning environment.
lines.translation: 灵活座位被定义为可移动的家具,用以创造一个富有吸引力的学习环境。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: It is a shift in practice from being teacher-focused to student-focused learning.
lines.translation: 它是从以教师为中心向以学生为中心学习的实践转变。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: For us, flexible seating has meant removing most of the traditional chairs and desks and introducing a variety of different seating options to promote student engagement.
lines.translation: 对我们而言,灵活座位意味着移除大部分传统的椅子和课桌,引入各种不同的座位选择来促进学生参与。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The use of rows and their minimal adaptations to "U" shape were traditionally intended to maximize on-task behavior and reduce distraction from the teacher.
lines.translation: 使用排列及其向"U"形的最小调整,传统上旨在最大化专注行为并减少对教师的干扰。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Teachers tend to still use this format because of either the need to control students or the belief that the teacher is the most important person in the room.
lines.translation: 教师倾向于仍然使用这种形式,原因要么是需要控制学生,要么是认为教师是教室里最重要的人。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Now our students have a range of different seating options, including a floor desk, couches, stools, bean bags, and the traditional desk-and-chair.
lines.translation: 现在我们的学生有一系列不同的座位选择,包括地板书桌、沙发、凳子、豆袋椅以及传统的课桌椅。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: From our experience so far, flexible seating enhances student ownership of space and engagement in learning, while reducing rates of student disengagement and disciplinary actions.
lines.translation: 根据我们迄今为止的经验,灵活座位增强了学生对空间的所有权和学习参与度,同时降低了学生脱离学习和纪律处分的比率。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: It is a win for all concerned.
lines.translation: 这对所有相关方来说都是双赢。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Dozens of British students arriving for their first day of school on Tuesday were sent home over their shoes.
lines.translation: 周二,数十名英国学生因鞋子问题在开学第一天被遣返回家。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: About 30 students were turned away from Taverham High School in Norfolk, England.
lines.translation: 英格兰诺福克郡Taverham高中约有30名学生被拒之门外。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Headteacher, Dr Roger Harris, confirmed that this was due to a change in the school's uniform policy.
lines.translation: 校长Roger Harris博士证实,这是由于学校校服政策的变化。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Harris, who became headteacher this year, said he notified parents of the updated rules in an email in June.
lines.translation: 今年新上任的Harris表示,他在6月份通过电子邮件通知了家长更新后的规定。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The price of school uniforms can spark panic among families struggling with the high cost of living.
lines.translation: 校服价格可能让那些苦于高昂生活成本的家庭感到恐慌。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Nearly all British schools have uniforms.
lines.translation: 几乎所有英国学校都有校服。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: They cost parents an average of £337 per year for each secondary school child.
lines.translation: 家长平均每年为每个中学生支付337英镑的校服费用。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: According to the new rules, students of Taverham are required to wear smart black shoes appropriate for the workplace, Harris held that strengthened rules around school uniforms improved student outcomes and behavior.
lines.translation: Harris认为, 校服的强化规则能改善学生的成绩和行为。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: But for some parents, the school's restrictions are an unnecessary burden.
lines.translation: 但对于一些家长来说,学校的限制是不必要的负担。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: As annual inflation climbs over 10%, many households are on tight budgets.
lines.translation: 随着年通胀率攀升至10%以上,许多家庭的预算都很紧张。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Private rental prices in Britain rose 3.2% over the 12 months to July 2022, the largest jump since 2016.
lines.translation: 截至2022年7月的12个月里,英国私人租房价格上涨了3.2%,这是自2016年以来的最大涨幅。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Soaring energy bills have made things worse.
lines.translation: 飙升的能源账单使情况更加恶化。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Lucinda May, mum of a Taverham student, said that she had to ask her parents for £65 to buy her child the correct pair of shoes.
lines.translation: Taverham学生家长Lucinda May说,她不得不向父母要65英镑给孩子买一双符合规定的鞋子。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: May said that the school's uniform policy showed the lack of regard for parents dealing with the high cost of living.
lines.translation: May表示,学校的校服政策显示出对正在应对高昂生活成本的家长缺乏关照。
